messages.subject: Project Aquilo - response draft (v3)
messages.plaintextBody:
Hannah,

Attached is our response draft (v3). In summary, our client's position is:

- Liability: fixed aggregate cap of £4,000,000, with a £5,000,000 sub-cap for the IP indemnity; LDs count towards the cap (clause 11.3)
- Shortfall: retained as a binding payment but reduced from 15% to 8% (clause 6.2)
- Payment: held at 45 days
- LDs: restored to 0.5%/week, 10% cap, sole and exclusive remedy
- Warranty: held at 24 months
- Indexation: CPI but capped at 4% p.a. (clause 7.2)
- Termination for convenience: held at post-third-anniversary, 6 months' notice

We think this is a fair landing zone and hope Calderwater will agree. Happy to have a call.

Kind regards,

Elena Marchetti
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
T +44 (0)20 7946 0048
whitfieldcarter.com
